errors.meaning: Malformed JSON, wrong JSON types, or unknown top-level fields.
API key missing or invalid while the daemon requires keys.
API key lacks the scope (read/write/admin) for this operation.
Managed writes requested but no signer is configured.
No collection with this name is registered on the daemon.
No live entity with this key or id in the collection at as_of_block.
Unknown path or method.
A collection with this name already exists on the daemon.
The signer does not own the entity it must patch, delete or extend.
The Arkiv transaction reverted. Extension field revert_error holds the Solidity error name.
Idempotency-Key reused with a different request body.
Request body above 32 MiB, or one entity above the 128 KiB Arkiv bytes budget.
Content-Type is not application/json.
A field value is out of range or inconsistent. Extension field 'field' names the JSON pointer.
Vector fails pgvector or VectorBytes validation. Extension 'vb_error' holds a VB_* code when applicable.
Vector dimension differs from the collection column dimension.
Filter does not parse or type-check. Extension 'position' holds the byte offset for 'where' strings.
Daemon rate limit exceeded. Retry-After header gives seconds.
Unexpected daemon error. Report with the request id.
Endpoint or option not available in this daemon build. Check GET /v1/version capabilities.
Upstream Arkiv RPC failed (transport error, HTTP 5xx/429 from the node).
Collection is bootstrapping or the daemon is degraded. Retry-After header gives seconds.
The request exceeded its deadline inside the daemon.
consistency.min_block was not reached within consistency.timeout_ms. Extension 'as_of_block' holds the current block.

vectorbytes_errors.meaning: Blob shorter than the fixed header for its type.
High nibble of byte 2 is not 1.
Low nibble of byte 2 is not 1..4.
Reserved flag bits 1-7 of byte 3 are set.
The pgvector 'unused' field is not zero.
dim outside pgvector limits for the type.
Blob length differs from the exact length the header implies.
A value is NaN or infinite.
sparsevec indices not strictly ascending (includes duplicates).
sparsevec contains an explicit zero value.
bit padding bits in the last byte are not zero.
